observations.before_signature: Separate ny-* header, hero, cards and seasonal visual language with slogan Новогодний корпоратив — живо, умно и без неловкости.
observations.after_signature: Main-site hero classes and portrait are reused; direct H1 is three lines; Проверить дату is fully visible at y=763..819; scrollWidth equals 390.
observations.observed_visible_result: Mobile now uses the established main-site composition and controls, with no separate seasonal design system.

observations.before_signature: Seasonal page used its own sticky header, oversized custom typography, date rail and unique card system.
observations.after_signature: Seasonal page uses site-header glass fixed, standard hero, root buttons and root card components; CTA bottom is 516; no overflow.
observations.observed_visible_result: Windowed laptop layout follows the same component geometry and density as the main site.

observations.before_signature: Custom seasonal hero used a different header, asymmetric decorative frame and the rejected slogan.
observations.after_signature: Root and seasonal hero both render H1 at 45px/800/47.25px, button at 56px with 14px radius and rgb(255,122,69), portrait radius 16px and identical hero gradient.
observations.observed_visible_result: The first screen visibly matches the main site's approved design; only the service copy and CTA destination differ.

observations.before_signature: Custom ny-* system visually separated the seasonal route from the corporate website.
observations.after_signature: Main-site header, hero grid, tags, buttons and portrait are rendered; CTA bottom is 639; form remains present; no overflow.
observations.observed_visible_result: Desktop page reads as a content variant of the existing site rather than a newly invented landing design.

observations.before_signature: Custom seasonal components did not share the root site's responsive token system.
observations.after_signature: The route inherits the root site's wide-screen container and typography tokens; CTA bottom is 742; scrollWidth equals 1984.
observations.observed_visible_result: Wide layout remains bounded and visually identical in language to the main corporate site.
